blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Thirty former New People’s Army (NPA) rebels in Agusan del Sur took another step toward full reintegration into civilian life after completing a six-day deradicalization and values formation workshop, a social welfare official said. Razel Montemor, Provincial Social Welfare and Development Office Chief, said the former communist guerrillas attended the workshop held late last month at the Balay Kalandang Halfway House in Sitio New Leyte, Barangay Awa, Prosperidad town. The mainstreaming program was conducted along with the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) and the Philippine Army’s 26th Infantry Battalion (26IB). READ: 31 […]...
